notes.title: 20% Halloween Sale! Localization added for Portuguese (Brazil) and German!
notes.content:
Hey all! Come hang out on [url=https://discord.gg/famAakEBJX]discord [/url]<33 

Exciting new patch today with lots of new features and upgrades! To celebrate there is a 20% discount from Oct 29th to Nov 4th <33.

[h1]Localization[/h1]
New languages are available for German and Brazilian players!

The game should detect your language on first launch but if not you can select your language at Pause menu > Settings > Game > select your language using the Language drop down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42829273/4f528940917c3d0c620566e615df7768a70d7860.png[/img]

Thank you so much to the immaculate minds of [url=joelstranslator@gmail.com]JoelSTranslator (PT-Br) [/url] and Lequitside (DE) for the amazing work!

[h1]New sprite![/h1]
One of the late game enemies, Hak, has been completely redesigned and expanded on thanks to the amazing talent of the legendary artist [url=https://saltandpixel.com]Salt & Pixel[/url].
[h2]Old[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42829273/1854194660e46842b559bf169eaa272e71bdbfc5.gif[/img]
[h2]New[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42829273/ecc0e032df916d05e69ee235d9a1a691e740a7b2.gif[/img]

[h1]Upgraded animations[/h1]
A much less prodigious artist (myself) has updated and (mostly) de-janked a few more animations for Charlet as well:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42829273/93722cbedaaa357b4d74750483c2a63407af5efa.gif[/img]

[h1]Cheating?!?[/h1]
I built a drop down console for entering cheat codes! There are only two cheats as of now but I may add some more in the future for fun <33. You'll have to figure them out on your own! The terminal can be accessed by pressing ctrl+`.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Portuguese (Brazil) translations
[*]Added German translations
[*]Added cheat menu (summon with ctrl+`)
[*]Updated Hak with new animations
[*]Updated Damnation, Cane ov Muna, Cane ov Loden and Cane ov Elding animations
[*]Added slow fall animation
[*]Fixed delinquent trajectory indicators
[*]Expanded long jump tutorial
[*]New font
[*]Bosses will no longer pause their stamina recharge when struck while recovering from stuns
[*]Fixed items still being visible in menu on new files
[*]Fixed default item slots
[*]Fixed attack animations locking while against walls or stunned
[/list]

notes.title: Locked levels fixed
notes.content:
Hello! Small bugfix <3

[list]

[*]Fixed some z-index issues with the new sword animation

notes.title: New attack animation for Charlet!
notes.content:
Hello!

Thank you so much everyone! Early access has been a huge success for me so I've been able to start commissioning some upgrades to improve the look of the game and expand to new regions as well. I've already started working hard with some wonderful artists and translators to help meet the early access goals. Good progress is being made <333.

While all that has been going on I'm still working on the final platforming challenge and picking away at whatever else I can find :D.

[h1]Charlet's Sword Attack[/h1]
A lot of the animations in the game right now are purely functional with very little flare so I thought I'd go thru and make some improvements myself while soliciting new commissions. I'll be doing a lot of work on Charlet's sprite so expect some more aesthetic changes to come!

[h2]The Old[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42829273/6679b0b46662d81ace24519c1d6aabf67bef9dc4.gif[/img]

[h1]Other Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Camera should be a little smoother at 60fps now
[/list]

[h1]Best Indie Games Feature[/h1]
I also had the pleasure of being featured in another Best Indie Games showcase! Very grateful to them for some good exposure <33. They even included some helpful advice for future releases in their showcase:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z3Heeq_JVuI&t=268

notes.title: Early Access Release and V0.13.24!
notes.content:
Hey all!

The campaign is finished and ready for Early Access!

My six month plan for EA is to open up the full campaign for players to gather feedback as well as to gather funding and data for upgraded sprites and translations. I also have a hidden secret level that will be under construction for a few weeks during early EA.

Additionally, I've pushed an update with maaany bugfixes and a few new features!

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enemies will now flinch! This was always in the game and I never noticed it was broken until a couple weeks ago. :D.
[/list]

[h1]Language Support prep[/h1]
[list]
[*] I've set up the game to support other languages in the future. 
[*] I'll be giving priority to languages based on engagement.
[*] English is still the only language currently supported <3.
[/list]

notes.title: Next Fest stream and new patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42829273/8af99fd8c3c4506cde4412da25307067e090e206.png[/img]

[h2]Next fest stream! [/h2]

Hey all! I'm very excited to be playing through the demo of Amata on twitch [b]Today, June 10th from 4pm - 8pm EST [/b]for Steam Next Fest!! I'll be starting a fresh play through of the demo every hour on the hour with some special previews of EA content. Between each play through I'll be taking questions and stressing systems. There should be a stream pretty much every day this week following the same format with some other games that have influenced me mixed in. Hope to see you there <3!

[h2]V0.13.21[/h2]

There is also a new patch coming today featuring some subtle changes to fundamental systems:

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]added camera smoothing option
[*]added a pinch more air control
[*]wall jumps should be more forgiving for mkb players
[*]increase Raziel charm damage granted from 7% to 10% per charge 
[*]removed defense stats from the level up menu

[/list]

[list]

notes.title: Amata V0.13.15
notes.content:
Hey! If you're reading this, thank you! I love you!

Haven't finished anything notable lately but I do have a couple of things to update you all on. 

[h1]Next Fest[/h1]

I mentioned this last time but I've signed up Amata for June Next Fest! Very much looking forward to seeing what the community has to say about the game. Hoping for the best!

Since the game is finished and ready for early access I will be focusing mostly on promotion ahead of Next Fest. In addition to this I will still be eagerly addressing any issues/ worthy features that come up along the way. If you have anything to report please don't hesitate, I'm very active on [url=https://discord.gg/famAakEBJX]Discord[/url]. I've also finished compiling some footage for a new trailer and screenshots as the existing set is a bit out of date.

[h1]Display settings[/h1]

I've integrated some window and resolution settings into the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854903/0047653e1680146a828fdb4436d82305cca0f043.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854903/00166e5973aba9ab81664484b65eaf4ee84522a9.png[/img]

These should be pretty responsive and the full screen modes will fit to a wide variety of aspects without much trouble (I hope). All resolutions less than full screen are limited to 16:9. 

[h1]Aesthetics[/h1]

It is now night time in Muldahara for a cozier atmosphere:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854903/10b945f1d6700cd1837b7437b496515748611976.png[/img]

Finally, I felt that The Memetic Expanse was a little bare compared to the other levels. This was initially to improve readability for the tutorial but I wanted to foster a better sense of exploration so added a little flare:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854903/7302503d746ab44641acff49029345b636b4a5c8.png[/img]

Come hang out on [url=https://discord.gg/famAakEBJX]Discord[/url] if you'd like to talk or get involved with play testing. If you haven't checked out the demo yet it is free and all progress carries over to the full game!

Thanks so much again for checking out Amata! <33

notes.title: Amata 0.13.9
notes.content:

[h3]General[/h3]

[*]fix softlock during arbor fight in Muldahara (?)

[*]line up timed platforms in 2nd hive histhana

[*]widen final column in the path ov hum
[*]make hall longer before ragakeet
